Roughly half to two-thirds of the seeds show noticeable purple blotching, while the remainder appear predominantly pale yellow. The most striking visual feature is the bold, irregular deep purple discoloration covering large portions of the seed coat on multiple seeds, contrasting sharply against the pale yellow base color.
